branchName.instructions: Use a short kebab-case slug describing the change, e.g. add-nvchad, fix-paseo-host-allowlist, polish-dotfiles. Lead with a verb (add/fix/drop/update/polish/...), no type prefix (no feat/, fix/), and no issue number segment — this repo has no issue tracker integration.

commitMessage.instructions: Use Conventional Commits: '<type>(<optional scope>): <description>' on one line, all lowercase, imperative mood, no trailing period, under 100 characters. Types in use: feat, fix, docs, style, refactor, test, ci, chore, revert. Scope is the tool or config area being changed (omp, herdr, nvim, zsh, paseo, fleet, ssh, ghostty, starship, atuin, brewfile, ci, setup) — omit it for repo-wide changes. Prefer a full descriptive clause over a terse fragment, e.g. 'fix(paseo): correct the daemon's host allowlist and boot-time restart limit' or 'fix(zsh): put the base path in zshenv so non-interactive shells get it'. Add a body only when the change needs the reasoning recorded.
